Trend — Pod Miss QnP%, Store IGCC%, Top-50 POD incidence% (left axis) & defects removed (right axis)

Trend of the numbers — value per period and change vs the previous period (▼ green = down / improving on complaint metrics, ▲ red = up)

Each week header shows its day count (e.g. W24 (7d)). Rate metrics (QnP%, IGCC%, incidence%) are day-count-independent; count metrics (POD complaints, defects removed) scale with days, so a partial latest week reads low.

Store trend direction — Pod Miss QnP Actual% latest period vs the previous period, with each store's target. 📉 Reduced = improving (QnP fell), 📈 Upward = worsening (QnP rose). Activity column: ✅ Done = removed defect this period, ❌ Not Done = no defect removed. Follows the Day/Week toggle above.

📉 Reduced trend — improving (biggest drop first)

📈 Upward trend — worsening (biggest rise first)

Store-wise trend

Store-level Pod Miss QnP% trend from W23 to current week, classified by trend direction only — no targets used. Classification is based on linear regression slope across all weeks a store has data. Improving = slope < 0 (QnP% falling week-on-week). Worsening = slope > 0 (rising). Flat/Mixed = near-zero or inconsistent. Stores with fewer than 2 weeks of data are excluded.

All stores — weekly Pod Miss QnP% trend (sorted: best slope first; sparkline = W23→latest; slope pp/week)

📉 Improving stores (QnP% trending down — best improvement first)

📈 Worsening stores (QnP% trending up — worst deterioration first)

Top-30 POD articles (summary)

Defect quantity removed (source: the Audit tab), broken down by store and by item, plus an Available Yes/No (does the store stock that item — opening stock > 0 ever).
→

Defect removed by store — store × day

cell = defect qty removed that day/week; Σ defect = total; Top-30 avail = how many of the 30 reference items the store stocks (X/30).

Defect removed by item — all stores

cell = defect qty removed; pick a store above to drill into a single store.

Top-30 availability — date-wise

Columns = opening-stock dates (or business weeks). All stores: cell = how many of the 30 are in stock that day/week (X/30), Overall = stocked on any day. Pick a store → rows become the 30 items with ✓/✗ per day/week + count avail. (Uses opening-stock dates, independent of the date range above.)
Store IGCC% = Sum(ORDERS_IGCC) / Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL), from the Store_inc tab — by store, day-on-day and week-on-week.
→

Fleet IGCC% trend

Overall fleet IGCC% — day by day

All stores in the current filter combined, one row per day. Fleet IGCC% = Sum(ORDERS_IGCC)/Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL) that day. Follows the Day/Week toggle below.

Store IGCC% — store × day

cell = IGCC% that day/week = Sum(ORDERS_IGCC)/Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL); Overall IGCC% = ratio over the whole range; Week adds WoW change. Sorted worst (highest) first.

Store IGCC% trend direction — Store IGCC% latest week vs the previous week (week-on-week, all stores). 📉 Reduced = improving (IGCC% fell), 📈 Upward = worsening (IGCC% rose).

📉 Reduced trend — improving (biggest drop first)

📈 Upward trend — worsening (biggest rise first)

Do stores that remove defects have a lower Pod Miss QnP Actual%? Each period, stores split into Defect removed (removed ≥1 defect that day/week, from the Audit tab) vs Not removed; each cohort's QnP% = Sum(IGCC)/Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL) pooled over its stores (order-weighted). Gap = removed − not-removed (negative/green = removing defects relates to fewer complaints).
→

Top-30 items removed

Pick a single store above to see, out of the 30 reference items (the Top 30 tab), how many it removed defects on (X/30) and the qty removed per item — over the selected date range. ✓ = removed, ✗ = not removed.

Pod Miss QnP Actual% — Defect-removed vs Not-removed cohorts

Cohort comparison — day by day

per period: each cohort's stores, orders, IGCC, Pod Miss QnP%; Gap = removed − not. Week adds WoW on the gap.

Store-wise comparison — store × day (follows the Day/Week toggle above)

one row per store: total defect qty removed, periods it removed, overall Pod Miss QnP Actual%, then its QnP% per day. Green cell = the store removed defects that period (shows −N def); green left-border = removed somewhere in range. Click a header to sort.

Item-wise defect-removal trend — item × day (scope: all stores, follows the Day/Week toggle above)

one row per item: Σ defect = total qty removed in range, then defect qty removed per day (red heat by magnitude, day-by-day or week-by-week). From the Audit tab; pick a store above to scope to that store, else aggregated across all tracked stores. Sorted most-removed first; click a header to sort.

Item defect removed — store-wise, with POD bucket % prev / same / next day (scope: all stores)

Aggregated: one row per store × item (summed over the date range) — Σ defect removed, removal days, then the store's POD bucket Pod Miss QnP Actual% (Sum(IGCC)/Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL), order-weighted) pooled over the day before, the removal day, and the day after each removal date. Day wise: one row per store × item × removal date — that day's defect qty and the store's POD% on the day before / that day / the day after. Δ (next − prev): green = next-day lower (improved). POD bucket is store-level (no item split) and lags ~2 days, so next-day may be "—" for recent dates. Pick a store above to scope. Sorted most-removed first; click a header to sort.

Before vs after removal — defect-removed cohort trend (day by day)

only stores that removed defects in range. Each store is split at its first removal date: Before = its periods before removal, After = on/after. Pooled order-weighted. Follows the Day/Week toggle above.

Before vs after — per removing store

each store's avg Pod Miss QnP Actual% before vs on/after its first removal date, and the change (Δpp; green = improved/down, red = up). Click a header to sort.
Week-on-week comparison of the two most recent weeks (W? = current week−2, W? = current week−1). POD bucket (Pod Miss QnP Actual%) = Sum(IGCC)/Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL) from POD BUCKET — the main metric; Store IGCC% = Sum(ORDERS_IGCC)/Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL) from Store_inc. ▼ green = decrease (improvement), ▲ red = increase. "% change" is relative to the earlier week.

Top-30 POD articles — Pod Miss QnP %

Item-level incidence % = Sum(IGCC) / Sum(unique ORDERS_TOTAL) (ORDERS_TOTAL deduped per store×day), POD (SPOC) only, aggregated across stores. Top 30 by the latest week; grey sub-line = raw IGCC count. "new" = no incidence in the earlier week. Click a header to re-sort.
Our tracked Top-50 stores vs the rest of Bangalore, from the ALL STORES tab (CITY = Bangalore only). IGCC% = Sum(ORDERS_IGCC) / Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL) (same formula as Store IGCC), pooled across each group (order-weighted). Gap = Top-50 − Rest (negative/green = the Top-50 outperform the rest).

Top-50 vs Rest IGCC% trend

Top-50 vs Rest — day by day

per period: each group's orders, IGCC orders, IGCC% (Sum(ORDERS_IGCC)/Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL)); Gap = Top-50 − Rest (pp). Week adds WoW change on each IGCC%.
Our tracked Top-50 stores vs the rest of Bangalore (BAU), from the Top 50 Vs Bau Pod Miss tab. POD miss % = Sum(IGCC) / Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL) (Pod bucket only), pooled across each group (order-weighted). Gap = Top-50 − Rest (negative/green = the Top-50 outperform the rest).

Top-50 vs Rest POD miss% trend

Top-50 vs Rest — day by day

per period: each group's orders, POD IGCC, POD miss% (Sum(IGCC)/Sum(ORDERS_TOTAL)); Gap = Top-50 − Rest (pp). Week adds WoW change on each POD miss%.
Our tracked Top-50 stores vs the rest of Bangalore, from the Overall Wastage tab. Wastage% = Sum(NE_AMT) / Sum(GMV) (NE rupee wastage ÷ GMV), pooled across each group (GMV-weighted). Gap = Top-50 − Rest (negative/green = the Top-50 have lower wastage).

per period: each group's GMV, NE wastage (₹), Wastage%; Gap = Top-50 − Rest (pp). Week adds WoW change on each Wastage%.
Stores from Pivot All tab bucketed by Base IGCC (0.8% base, 0.2% step). Each slab has its own chart (Incentive solid, No-Incentive dashed) and 2 table rows. Green = improving vs W22+W23 baseline  |  Red = worsening.

Week-on-week table — all slabs

Each slab = 2 rows: Incentive then No-Incentive. Δ = vs W22+W23 baseline.
Week-on-week target achievement per store. A store achieves a metric when its actual is at/under target: POD miss Pod Miss QnP Actual% ≤ Pod Miss QnP Target, and Wastage NE wastage% ≤ Wastage guardrail%. The focus is stores hitting BOTH targets. ✓ green = achieved, ✗ red = over target.
Week = business week (Sun-anchored). Each period is scored against that period's own target.
